title: List skills
summary: List built-in, imported, and custom uploaded Skills available to agents.

response.name: data
response.description: Skill descriptors with source and version metadata.

title: Create skill
summary: Upload a reusable Skill package. A valid package contains one top-level folder with SKILL.md at its root.

parameters.name: files
parameters.description: Zip, .skill file, directory upload, or JSON file list.

parameters.name: display_title
parameters.description: Optional human label not included in model prompts.

response.name: id
response.description: Server-generated skill_... identifier for custom uploads.

response.name: compatibility
response.description: Authored Agent Skills environment requirements; descriptive only and never executed.

title: Get skill
summary: Fetch one Skill descriptor and package metadata.

title: Delete skill
summary: Delete or archive a custom uploaded Skill from the local workspace.

response.name: deleted
response.description: True when the Skill was removed.

title: List skill versions
summary: List a Skill's versions newest first. Custom Skills read the stored version records; built-in Anthropic Skills answer their catalog metadata read-only.

response.name: data
response.description: Published skill_version objects: id, skill_id, name, description, created_at, type.

title: Upload skill version
summary: Upload a new version of a custom Skill using the same package format as skill creation. The package's frontmatter name must match the Skill's name; a mismatch answers 409.

parameters.name: files
parameters.description: Zip, .skill file, directory upload, or JSON file list.

title: Delete skill version
summary: Delete one version and its stored package. Deleting the only remaining version answers 409; deleting the latest repoints latest_version at the newest survivor.

title: Download skill version
summary: Download a custom Skill version's stored package as a zip archive.

response.name: body
response.description: Zip archive whose entries are rooted at the Skill's name.
